method: Oxlint effective-line counts with blank lines and comments skipped and IIFEs included
provenance: Historical measurements from four private TypeScript source corpora. Corpus labels replace private repository names and revisions; these measurements are retained evidence, not publicly reproducible source links.
decision: Keep 300 file and 100 function effective lines as readability preferences, not operational capacity or healthy-behavior tripwires. The legacy tripwires field retains the configured values. Historical percentiles do not classify source roles or establish that larger code is unhealthy. Justified exemptions remain consumer-owned; the portable default adds none.
